Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

accent_color.description: Accent color applied to hosted pages such as the Terms of Service accept button

compliance_emails.description: When non-empty, compliance Request for Information emails are sent only to these addresses instead of all instance members

customer_rfi_emails_enabled.description: Whether customer (customer) Request for Information notification emails are sent for this instance. Omit to leave unchanged.

email_notifications.description: Whether email notifications are enabled for this instance

logo_url.description: Logo shown to your customers on hosted pages such as the Terms of Service acceptance page

partner_tos_link.description: Passthrough Terms of Service: the page where your customers are presented with the BlindPay Terms of Service

partner_tos_screenshot.description: Passthrough Terms of Service: a screenshot of how the BlindPay Terms of Service are displayed to your customers. Must be a file_url returned by POST /upload with bucket documents.

partner_tos_terms_accepted.description: Passthrough Terms of Service: accept the current Passthrough Terms of Service Partner Agreement (https://blindpay.com/passthrough-tos-partner-agreement). Dashboard users only; requires partner_tos_link and partner_tos_screenshot.

require_passkey.description: Whether passkey verification is required for protected actions
